name: cirilinfo-saas
description: CirilInfo SaaS platform: public website, customer portal, admin portal, API and worker.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci && npm --prefix e2e ci
scripts.dev:worker: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/api run start:worker
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test -- --watch=false
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
